attributes.title: 2027 Evidence-Based School Counseling Conference
attributes.venue: University of North Carolina at Charlotte
attributes.organizer: Evidence Based School Counseling Conference Advisory Council
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Evidence-Based School Counseling Conference takes place at the University of North Carolina at Charlotte, with a research day on March 5 and the main conference on March 6 and 7, 2027. It focuses on research and data-driven practice for school counselors, district leaders and counselor educators.

The EBSCC Advisory Council is an NBCC Approved Continuing Education Provider (ACEP No. 7478). Attendees earn NBCC clock hours for sessions they attend live and evaluate; the total number of hours was not published.

Registration opens December 11, 2026. The main conference costs $250 through January 31, 2027, and $325 after that; students pay $125. The research day is booked separately at $100, or $75 for students. Keynote speakers and the 2027 program were not published yet when we checked.
